prediction_text: 奥巴马胜：奥巴马先夺民主党提名，继而在2008年11月4日大选中击败麦凯恩，当选美国总统。土星—天王星对冲于选举日成相，主变革压倒守成、老将不敌新人。
basis:
tradition: The card has no tradition/system field; decided by genre — an election forecast reported in May 2008 — as western astrology (electional/mundane reading as reported).
systems_used: western astrology
Indicator chain: Saturn–Uranus opposition begins exactly on Election Day, last seen 45 years earlier: Uranus (change, the outsider, youth) challenging Saturn (the establishment, age, incumbency structures). McCain embodies the Saturn pole (elder statesman, continuity); Obama embodies the Uranus pole (change candidacy). An opposition perfecting on the day itself tips the contest to the change pole. At asking time Obama leads the nomination race but has not clinched — the reading extends the same direction through the nomination to the general election. Object check: the verdict lands on the election winner, the exact object asked.
第八节功量核 — 功量清单：助成线（主奥巴马胜）①Saturn–Uranus opposition exact on Election Day favouring the change candidate (source: given configuration; object: election outcome; direction: pro-change; state: exact on the decisive day); 助成线②Obama already leads the nomination race at asking time (fact-level support, state: leading); 压制线①McCain is presumptive nominee of the incumbent party with establishment weight (direction: suppressing; state: background only, no chart factor given). Pro-change lines hold the only chart factor; band set at a clear Obama win, not a coin-flip.
主线认定：The Saturn–Uranus opposition line is the working main line (the sole dated chart factor, exact on Election Day); the outcome's direction and band follow it.
